prod.management: loopback listeners plus reviewed authenticated private gateway

admin.ui_db_metrics: loopback only; authenticated operator path required
admin.outbound: target management HTTPS and metrics HTTPS with distinct per-target credentials

learning.host_transfers: approved dataset read and candidate write only; per-prefix IAM

common.NACL: stateless; explicit response ephemeral ports required
common.docker_firewall: verify published ports and DOCKER-USER behavior; UFW alone is insufficient
